runs.name: Ambu A/S, Nasdaq Copenhagen AMBU B; not an SEC registrant; unsponsored ADR one to one (Citibank F-6 POS 0001193805-18-000045); 1:5 split January 2018; no rename, merger or spin-off seen
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **DKK 76.20** a class B share (Nasdaq Copenhagen, 2026-10-13, aggregator, flagged; ADR equivalent USD 11.41, the ADR's own last trade a stale USD 11.00). Shares **260,652,702** (34,320,000 class A unlisted and 234,974,389 class B, equal economic rights, total 269,294,389, less 8,641,687 treasury B shares after the buyback finished, company announcement of 2026-09-21); cap **DKK 19,862m**; net cash **DKK 509.6m** (lease liabilities of about DKK 560m left out). Sovereign **3.50%** (Danmarks Nationalbank debt office, DGB 0.25% 2052 auction of 2026-09-02, six weeks old, no daily official series found, flagged). Documents read in place of accession numbers (departure 2 of the brief): Annual Reports 2014/15 to 2024/25 (ambu.com), the Q1 to Q3 2025/26 interim reports, the 2024/25 remuneration report, the outlook and buyback announcements (two read on redistributor sites, flagged); one figure cross-checked (operating cash flow 2024/25 DKK 791m in the filed cash flow statement, the five-year summary and the Q3 report). `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` cannot serve a non-SEC name; arithmetic by hand (departure 3). Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report's business description, risk-management section and management's review, stated in the run file. Competitors: the annual reports name no rival; Boston Scientific and Teleflex chosen by the analyst from their 10-K data, whole-company margins only, a weak comparison, flagged; Olympus and Karl Storz, which would matter most, not SEC filers and not read. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: single-use endoscopy decides (about 60% of revenue and called by the filer "the more profitable" business; one reported segment, so the deciding part was chosen by a CONVENTION of the run, revenue share plus the filer's statement); its ten-year economics cannot be foreseen: the 2021/22 guidance of 15-19% organic growth and a 7-9% EBIT margin delivered 4.3% and 2.7%; the Invendo GI technology bought in 2018 impaired by DKK 327m in 2023/24; EBIT margin 21.6% to -0.6% and back to 13.0%; three strategy resets and three chief executives since 2019; the filer's own risk "Pace of market creation and product acceptance in single-use endoscopy". Anesthesia and Patient Monitoring easier to see but does not decide. Q2 to Q12 not reached. After the stop: Boston Scientific operating margin -0.8% to 18.0% 2016 to 2025, Teleflex 13.1% to 22.4% to 2022 then 5.9% to 15.1% on restated figures; Anesthesia lost U.S. volume after price increases, its growth guidance cut twice in 2025/26. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: window 2020/21 to 2024/25; owner cash DKK 7.2m a year with all spending deducted, DKK 229.4m on the maintenance case (yearly -300, -522, 112, 433, 313 DKKm all spending); the series changes sign, so the no-growth case alone, maintenance central, all-equity, purchases deducted ten years; range **DKK 27.47 a share** (USD 4.11; equity-only DKK 23.19; 29.42 with no purchases deducted, 3.12 all spending) against DKK 76.20; no case earns the floor (central about 1.0% to 1.3% on enterprise value, the most generous stream allowed 5.5%); fair **DKK 10.13 all-equity** (USD 1.52), DKK 7.36 equity-only; no alert (box not OUT at Q7). Balance sheets 2016 to 2025: equity up about DKK 5.0bn, of which about DKK 3bn from share sales (DKK 667m 2017/18, DKK 1,225m at DKK 262 in 2021, DKK 1,054m at DKK 93 in 2022/23) against ten-year net profit of DKK 2.8bn; capitalised development about DKK 140m to DKK 1,313m; inventory 13.8% of revenue (2016), 27.5% (2022), 21.1% (2025); debt repaid from the 2023 issue, net cash since 2024; 2026 buybacks at DKK 85.91 and DKK 66.78 average, above every case. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: yearly guidance, revised and in 2021/22 missed; an adjusted margin featured (14.5% against 11.0% reported, Q2 2025/26); special items in four of seven years; Class II recalls and a Class I recall the analyst could not verify, from one web search, not the FDA databases. Contamination declared by the analyst: ACHC commit subjects, the AYI and ARCB research folder names, the memory index's queue-state line, other runs named in `.gitignore` comments; none concerns Ambu; no blind-listed file opened. Commits 9727554c, cfc984e7, e36151c9. Citations: the analyst's check (`check_ids.py`) re-run by the dispatcher: 30 citations, 27 distinct ids, all in the ledger, 28 quoted fragments in their rows, no slip, no E-id. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) Q2's business-of-parts paragraph needs profit by part, which this filer does not report; (2) the serial-acquirer test does not say which owner-cash case is its denominator, and here the answer flips (not serial on maintenance, serial on all spending); (3) a single-case range has one end for Part VII's averaged fair price; (4) whether purchases are charged in a range that is no-growth from year one; (5) how old an issuing-authority sovereign may be when the authority publishes only at auctions; (6) Q1's test 5 when insiders do publish forecasts and miss them, NATURE or a WORK question about the management. Could not get: profit by business, market shares and prices by product, a daily official Danish long-bond series, stock pay for 2015/16 and 2016/17, the FDA databases directly.
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): the Danish single-use endoscope maker, about 60% of revenue in the newer and more profitable business, whose ten-year economics cannot be foreseen: 2021/22 guidance of 15-19% growth and a 7-9% margin delivered 4.3% and 2.7%, the Invendo GI technology impaired by DKK 327m, EBIT margin 21.6% to -0.6% to 13.0%, three strategy resets and three chief executives since 2019, about DKK 3bn of shares sold over the decade. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range DKK 27.47 a share against DKK 76.20 (no-growth case alone), fair DKK 10.13 all-equity (DKK 7.36 equity-only). Integrity facts recorded, not judged: guidance missed, an adjusted margin featured, special items in four of seven years, recalls.
